notes: RBox contraction paired with finance-replace-0011: removes the subproperty cfo_of ⊑ works_for, so every query expects 'does not know'. Instances are the revision's (Amy Hood at Microsoft, Colette Kress at Nvidia): the first asks whether the person could fail to work there (no), the second whether it follows (yes). A model that answers 'yes, she works there' after the edit uses world knowledge or the old property. Near unrelated asks the sibling relation 'is the chief executive officer of' into the same super-relation, which stays; far is the revision's. hops counts the premises as one bridge.
